{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check premises
print("Data shape:", df.shape)
print("Unique customer_segment values:", df['customer_segment'].unique())
print("Unique status values:", df['status'].unique())
print("Revenue dtype:", df['revenue'].dtype)
print("Revenue example:", df['revenue'].head(3).tolist())

# Check for QA orders
qa_orders = df[df['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print("Number of QA orders:", len(qa_orders))

# Check for -1 in customer_age (for context, not directly relevant here)
print("Number of -1 in customer_age:", (df['customer_age'] == -1).sum())"}
